criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to play music, songs, or albums by a specific artist, genre, time period, or platform.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: User requests weather conditions or a forecast for a specific location and time.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation or book a table at a restaurant or eating establishment.

categories.name: Rate Media
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating, score, or stars to a book, album, or other media item.

categories.name: Add To Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a song, track, album, or artist to a specific music playlist.

categories.name: Get Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: User wants to find movie schedules, showtimes, or cinema listings for specific films or theaters.

categories.name: Find Media
categories.definition: User wants to search for or locate a specific creative work such as a book, movie, game, picture, or show.
